newsitem.title: USA: U.S. can't confirm Iraqi attack on U.S. planes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. can't confirm Iraqi attack on U.S. planes.

text.p: The United States said on Saturday it could not confirm Iraq had fired surface-to-air missiles against U.S. warplanes policing no-fly zones in northern and southern Iraq.
"We've checked pretty thoroughly with all known parties and have nothing to confirm this report," a Pentagon spokeswoman said. She had no further comment.
Earlier, a White House official said the U.S. government was checking the report broadcast on Saturday by state-run Iraqi television.
"At this time we have no information to confirm that," White House spokesman Barry Toiv said.
The Iraqi television said, quoting a military spokesman, that the missiles had missed their targets. It did not say when the incident took place.

The United States extended the southern no-fly zone by one degree, almost to the outskirts of Baghdad, after Iraqi troops intervened in northern Iraq last weekend to help a Kurdish group wrest a key city from a rival Kurdish group. REUTER
